_comment: OrionLayer's OWN wording for the research select screen. Everything the GAME says comes from the player's files instead - the field and application names from TECHNAME.LBX (core/technames.py) and the panel's words from BILLTEXT.LBX (core/billtext.py). What is here is the wording OrionLayer owns: a title the original paints into TECHSEL art rather than printing, and the sentences it says when it cannot draw the list (decision 15 - a renderer draws what it is handed and does not know the words).
entry_boxes_note: The eight entry boxes carry NO SKIN. They wore the inner_panel ARTWORK until work order 166 part C, and Data's verdict on the live panel was that it does not fit them: they are drawn in code now, the way screens/planets/ draws its boxes - one fill and one rounded outline through Style.draw_plate, which is the helper the Planets screen and the colony list already share (core.researchpanel.draw_box). A box with no skin draws nothing of its own, which is what lets the drawing live where the rest of the panel's drawing lives. Marked inner_boxes_drawn in screen.py.
title: SELECT NEW RESEARCH
title_note: HD EXTENSION. The original's headline is part of the TECHSEL.LBX panel art and is not a string tech.cpp prints, so there is nothing to transcribe - doc/tech_change_reading.md section 3 has the panel's own labels as NOT SETTLED. Marked in screen.py and held by a smoke check.
